title: Credential behind a forged image header in an MCP tool result
description: An MCP tool returns image content whose base64 data starts with a PNG signature and header chunk, then continues with a plaintext synthetic credential instead of image data. The container prefix must not make the rest of the field exempt from inspection.
notes: The decoded data is the 8-byte PNG signature, a valid 13-byte IHDR chunk, and then the plaintext line AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID followed by the same synthetic credential-shaped value as mcp-tool-result-credential-014. There is no IDAT or IEND chunk, so the bytes are not a PNG image beyond their first 33 bytes. Pairs with mcp-tool-result-benign-image-027, which carries a complete valid PNG in the same field.
source: Model Context Protocol ImageContent (base64 data with mimeType); PNG Specification, file signature and chunk layout; synthetic credential
